0022600218.text: The Knicks, at home at 5-4, have won three straight and sit third in the Atlantic, 3 games back and fifth in the East, while the Cavaliers are 5-6, have lost two straight, and sit second in the Central, 2.5 games back and seventh in the East. New York leads the season series 1-0 after a 109-97 win in Cleveland on November 7, and it also won the 2025-26 season series 2-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0. Josh Hart is out for the Knicks with illness, and Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow) are out for Cleveland.
